Authentic Mexican Food in Vietnam
Nov 2021 • Friends
Coming to this place, is like visiting Mexico in Vietnam. I never thought i could find a place like this in Vietnam, specially when i have been trying to find the real mexican food even in some other latin countries, but i never could find the real taste of the mexican food. 

From the first bite to the last, there is not any other place like this, unless you go to Mexico... And they are in Vietnam ( Hanoi and Da Nang )... Just amazing and unveliable.

I would love to recommend even just one of their delicious dishes, but i can't... I can't choose one, i tried all of them, from the fish tacos to the enchiladas suizas... And all of them were amazing. Now i just make a selection of a few dishes from the list, and after a few orders, when i have completed the list, i start again from the first selection. I am really in love with this food. And the owners are really friendly, amazing service, and always offering the best and first quality products. Please guys, keep going and never ever go!!! WE NEED YOU IN VIETNAM!!!! Thanks a lot!!!

THE BEST MOST AUTHENTIC MEXICAN RESTAURANT IN HANOI!!
Nov 2021 • Family
I have lived in Hanoi for over 4 years, and Mexican Choice Art is simply the best!

The food is just FANTASTIC! Usually I go for the chilaquiles and enchiladas suizas, my son loves the baja tacos (fish tacos, reminds him when we visited Cancun), and my wife loves the vegetarian burritos, but the other day we tried their “gringas” (flour tortilla taco with pastor meat and melted cheese), chicken burritos, and mole, and those were superb!!

This is the only place that I have found so far that serves a proper michelada, and their agua de Jamaica is pretty good too. For dessert, I love it when they have “3 leches” cake, that is a taste of all over Latin America for you!

As a good latin restaurant, the owners are super friendly and helpful, the music in the background is a nice touch too!

Also, this place is super affordable! My whole family (4) can eat there for dinner and spend around $30-$35, and we eat a lot! 😂😂😂
